name: licoarc-for-codex
description: Independent Codex sub-agent bridge in the retained LicoArc plugin namespace.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work to Lico Arc providers without editing Codex models
interface.longDescription: Spawn async Lico Arc sub-agent jobs (default DeepSeek V4 Flash via Lico Arc model-forwarding profiles), poll or await completion, and keep Codex model provider / base_url / original model config untouched.
defaultPrompt: Use the Lico Arc sub-agent to draft a concise technical summary with DeepSeek, then return the result here.
Delegate a bounded research subtask to Lico Arc and await the job without changing my Codex model settings.
